question: In which of the following years did Sachindra Nath Sanyal establish a branch of Anushilan Samiti in Patna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1913**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sachindra Nath Sanyal** established a branch of **Anushilan Samiti** in **Patna in 1913**.
 
• Anushilan Samiti was a prominent revolutionary organization in Bengal and played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• It was established to promote physical, mental, and spiritual development among the youth of Bengal, with a focus on achieving independence from British rule.
 
• Sachindra Nath Sanyal was a key figure in the revolutionary movement and was associated with several other revolutionary activities and organizations.
 
• The establishment of the Patna branch helped to spread the revolutionary activities and ideology of Anushilan Samiti to other parts of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anushilan Samiti** was founded by **Promotha Mitter**, **Aurobindo Ghosh**, and **Deshbandhu Chittaranjan Das** in 1902.
 
• The organization was involved in several revolutionary activities, including planning and executing attacks on British officials and institutions.
 
• Sachindra Nath Sanyal later co-founded the **Hindustan Republican Association** (HRA) in 1924, which aimed to achieve independence through armed revolution.
 
• The HRA was later reorganized and renamed as the **Hindustan Socialist Republican Association** (HSRA) under the leadership of Bhagat Singh and Chandrashekhar Azad.
 
• Sanyal's contributions to the revolutionary movement were significant, and he is remembered as a prominent freedom fighter in Indian history.
